PolyMuter8.cpp:258 setChannels(outChans), with setVoltage(value, c) written per channel above

comment: The maker's tooltips on the mute buttons are numbered wrong: PolyMuter8.cpp:72-79 names the first two buttons both 'Mute #1' and the eighth 'Mute #7', so every button after the first reads one lower than the number printed beside it. The panel numbers are right. Shrink channels bypasses the fade entirely (:222-250 never touches ampValue). 'exclude -10v chans too' tests inValue > -10, so a channel at exactly -10V is dropped. The IN and OUT jacks carry whatever is patched, so they get no family.
